title: Phone list top bar: the 「⋮」 menu has no 「对象设置」 entry (the desktop list got it in #36487)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Noted by area s2-D while landing #36487 (PR #36612), outside that PR. Not claimed. Related: #36487.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`

## What happens

#36487 adds 「对象设置」 to the list page's top-right 「⋮」 menu, which opens the object in Studio for an admin. On a phone the list's top bar draws its own 「⋮」 menu (in `ObjectView.tsx`), and that menu does not have the entry.

## Ask

Give the phone 「⋮」 the same 「对象设置」 entry, under the same admin condition as the desktop one, reusing the desktop entry's action rather than a copy. Or, if the Studio is not usable on a phone, say so on this card and close it as not planned.

## Re-check

On a phone-width list page as an admin, open 「⋮」: 「对象设置」 is there when this is fixed.
